Preventing sub-pixel blind spots where thin wires or splats flicker on and off
Progressive multi-sample raymarching and area-light stratification

High-dimensional (>10D) path tracing where scrambled Sobol sequences excel
Spatial neighborhood clamping or YCoCg color-box anti-ghosting
